blocks.prompt: Class activity: number juft (even) ya taaq (odd) hai, jaanchne ka if-else statement likhein.
blocks.explanation: 2 se taqseem ki baqi istemal karein: if num % 2 == 0: print("Even") else: print("Odd").

items: if-else: shart sach ho to ek block, jhoot ho to doosra (15 par 'It's not a hot day').
